title: Parrot waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- perch branch -->
  <rect x='18' y='78' width='64' height='8' rx='4' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <rect x='18' y='78' width='64' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#b07a45'/>
  <!-- tail feathers -->
  <polygon points='48,74 44,96 54,96 58,74' fill='#d12f2f'/>
  <polygon points='50,74 48,94 56,94 56,74' fill='#e85d3d'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='17' ry='21' fill='#2fbf4f'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='56' rx='10' ry='16' fill='#4fe07a'/>
  <!-- wing -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='60' rx='9' ry='15' fill='#1f9e3e' transform='rotate(-15 60 60)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='60' rx='5' ry='12' fill='#3fd96a' transform='rotate(-15 60 60)'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='43' y='74' width='4' height='7' rx='2' fill='#c9a227'/>
  <rect x='53' y='74' width='4' height='7' rx='2' fill='#c9a227'/>
  <!-- waving arm -->
  <rect x='26' y='38' width='7' height='20' rx='3.5' fill='#1f9e3e' transform='rotate(-35 30 58)'/>
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='34' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#3fd96a' transform='rotate(-35 24 34)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='15' fill='#2fbf4f'/>
  <!-- cheek -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='36' r='4' fill='#f5d76e'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <polygon points='62,28 74,34 62,38' fill='#f2a33a'/>
  <polygon points='62,31 71,34 62,36' fill='#d9822b'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='27' r='5' fill='#f4f4f4'/>
  <circle cx='56.5' cy='27' r='3' fill='#25304d'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='25.5' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- crest -->
  <polygon points='44,19 40,8 48,16' fill='#d12f2f'/>
  <polygon points='50,17 50,5 55,16' fill='#e85d3d'/>
  <polygon points='56,19 62,9 60,20' fill='#f5d76e'/>
  <!-- wave lines -->
  <path d='M16,28 q-4,4 0,8' stroke='#7fe8a0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M12,24 q-6,6 0,12' stroke='#7fe8a0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
